title: Review follow-up of PR #38015: the knowledge_source id-to-name docs name the underscore exception
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38015 (#37740/#37741; L1-a ACCEPT 7223565918: "File one small card, or accept it by name"; dev report 7222932379 out-of-scope note; one card per PR, review-follow-ups exception) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 (suggested: docs text; the upgrade entry already states the exception) · reach: an author upgrading a knowledge source whose 18 `id` began with an underscore · evidence: read (dev report 7222932379; probe in PR #38015).
Dedupe: `is:issue "PR #38015"` → #37740, #37741 only; `is:issue knowledge_source id name underscore` → none open.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：知识源的 `id` 改为 `name` 后，文档说原有索引会被找回，但 `id` 以下划线开头的知识源要改名，会从头重建，旧索引留在旧 id 下，文档没写这个例外。
- 做什么：在两处文档里补上这个例外，以及如何清掉旧索引。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
`content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` (the `id` row of the 18 → 19 table) says the index is found again after `id` becomes `name`, with no exception. PR #38015's upgrade entry `knowledge-source-registration-governed` states that a source whose 18 id began with an underscore is renamed, built from nothing under the new name, and leaves the index under the old id with its adapter until `dropSource` is called with the old id as the source's name (probed in PR #38015). Add that exception and the `dropSource` step to the page. `.changeset/37304-knowledge-source-governed-type.md` (landed) carries the same row; correct it only if the changeset is still pending, as a deliberate correction with its declaration, otherwise leave it.

## Acceptance
- `knowledge.mdx` names the underscore exception and the `dropSource` cleanup, in the same words as the upgrade entry.
- `check:generated` and the docs gates green.

Blocked-by: #37740
